label: E01 Construction mapping
limitation: Conduit,wood,solar,battery,heater,cooler,vent in order; worker rate1 and preserve real seconds, excluding hauling,skills and failure.

label: E02 Fuel and refill
limitation: Unit fuel multiplier and ordinary non-atomic enabled machine with accessible fuel; requestedCount is method output even where full-state prevents creating a job. Partial fixtures use final delivered stack with no concurrent burn. HasFuel is not proof of PowerOn or output. No runtime fuel measurement.

label: E03 Solar roof factor
limitation: Desired output only, all generator gates enabled; no actual celestial orbit or enabled mod patches executed.

label: E04 Sky final operators
limitation: Final dot-to-glow and blending examples only; does not reproduce sun-vector geometry,latitude,season or all game conditions. maxGlow.4 is synthetic,not selected Core rain data.

label: E05 Connector search square
limitation: Connector-initiated search with single-cell active transmitters and no disallowed nets. New-transmitter attachment follows a different path.

label: E06 Cardinal network components
limitation: Handwritten graph flood over single-cell transmitter fixtures; not a call to PowerNetMaker and not3D connectivity validation.

label: E07 Battery balance
limitation: Continuous single-battery idealization excluding startup buffer,EMP,breakdown and tick-order quantization.

label: E08 Room temperature migration
limitation: Assumes cached old rooms are found by each new room. Original uses full old areas and ID deduplication, not the overlap alternative. Complex invalidation/reuse order requires runtime fixtures.

label: E09 Temperature serialization
limitation: Numeric encoding approximation using real-number arithmetic; not save-file roundtrip through the game.

label: E10 Update clocks
limitation: Thermal natural,Rare,heat pusher,closed door,open door,refuel in order. Project ceiling policy is illustrative; recompute heat from actual dt when rounding.

label: E11 Heater target clipping
limitation: Indoor powered heater, no concurrent thermal loss or other device updates.

label: E12 Cooler exhaust and obstruction
limitation: Indoor cold side; exhaust value is heat requested before any hot-side outdoor rejection. Last efficiency is unused because obstruction blocks operation.

label: E13 Through building exchange
limitation: Two indoor rooms,non-vacuum,no portal-occupancy side effect; arithmetic target is unweighted but changes divide by area and share a limiter. General mixed-outdoor/vacuum cases need separate models.

label: E14 Custom voxel unit mapping
limitation: Explicit project design: air volume/2 and heat preserved per real second, electricity/fuel per game day. Not original3D behavior; no six-face boundary exchange solver executed.

label: E15 Startup buffer despite surplus generation
limitation: Original algebra versus project day-length mapping with generator already PowerOn and sole pending175W consumer. Checks startup gate and separate candidate affordability only; no scheduling,random selection,float32 emulation or actual stored-energy deduction. For no-battery branch only s=0 is physically reachable; other s values deliberately probe the conditional algebra.
